Company Profile

A Pillar of Excellence in Qatar's Construction Industry

Delivering excellence across residential, commercial, and industrial sectors with an uncompromising commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability.

LandSlide Trading and Contracting Company, based in Doha, Qatar, has established itself as a premier player in the construction industry, known for its commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability. With a diverse portfolio of projects and a dedicated team of professionals, LandSlide has made significant contributions to Qatar’s rapidly evolving urban landscape.

Company Overview

LandSlide Trading and Contracting Company was founded with a vision to deliver excellence in every project, big or small. The company's philosophy revolves around a client-centric approach, ensuring that each project meets the highest standards of quality and safety. With a robust portfolio that spans residential, commercial, and industrial sectors, LandSlide has become synonymous with reliability and professionalism.

Core Values and Mission

At the heart of LandSlide’s operations are its core values: integrity, quality, and innovation. The company is committed to maintaining transparent and ethical business practices, building strong relationships with clients, partners, and suppliers. LandSlide’s mission is to be a leader in the construction industry, delivering projects that enhance the built environment and contribute to the economic growth of Qatar.

Key Projects and Achievements

Our footprint is etched across some of the most prestigious capital developments in the State of Qatar:

1

Msheireb Downtown Doha

One of LandSlide’s flagship projects, the Msheireb Downtown Doha, is a model of sustainable urban development. LandSlide contributed to the construction of this smart city district, focusing on sustainable building practices, advanced technology integration, and preserving the cultural heritage of Doha.

2

Lusail City Development

As part of Qatar’s visionary Lusail City project, LandSlide played a pivotal role in constructing infrastructure that supports this futuristic metropolis. The company’s involvement included building state-of-the-art residential complexes, commercial towers, and recreational facilities.

3

Salwa Beach Resort

LandSlide's expertise in luxury hospitality projects is exemplified in its work on the Salwa Beach Resort. The company was instrumental in constructing the resort’s high-end villas, sprawling pool areas, and exquisite landscaping, ensuring the resort met international standards of luxury and comfort.

4

Qatar Rail & Doha Metro

Contributing to the development of Qatar’s transportation network, LandSlide has been involved in constructing sections of the Qatar Rail project, providing efficient and sustainable public transport options for residents and visitors alike.

Commitment to Sustainability

LandSlide Trading and Contracting Company places a strong emphasis on sustainability, aligning with Qatar’s National Vision 2030 for sustainable development. The company adopts green building practices, uses eco-friendly materials, and implements energy-efficient technologies in its projects. By focusing on sustainability, LandSlide not only contributes to environmental preservation but also ensures long-term value for its clients.

Technological Innovation

Innovation is a cornerstone of LandSlide’s approach to construction. The company leverages the latest technologies in project management, design, and construction to enhance efficiency and precision. From using Building Information Modeling (BIM) for accurate project planning to implementing advanced construction techniques, LandSlide stays ahead of industry trends.

Safety and Quality Assurance

Safety is paramount in LandSlide’s operations. The company adheres to stringent safety protocols and standards to ensure a safe working environment for its employees and contractors. Quality assurance is also a key focus, with comprehensive quality control measures in place to guarantee that every project meets the highest standards of craftsmanship.

Workforce and Culture

LandSlide’s success is driven by its talented and diverse workforce. The company invests in training and development, ensuring that its employees are equipped with the latest skills and knowledge. The culture at LandSlide is one of collaboration, respect, and continuous improvement, fostering an environment where innovation thrives.

Community Engagement

LandSlide Trading and Contracting Company is committed to giving back to the community. The company engages in various corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives, supporting local charities, educational programs, and environmental conservation efforts. LandSlide believes in making a positive impact not only through its projects but also through its actions in the community.

Building a Better Future, One Project at a Time

LandSlide Trading and Contracting Company stands as a pillar of excellence in Qatar’s construction industry. With a focus on quality, innovation, and sustainability, LandSlide continues to shape the future of urban development in Qatar. The company’s commitment to delivering exceptional projects while upholding the highest standards of safety and integrity ensures its place as a trusted partner in Qatar’s growth and development.
